name: ReordeRe Lite – Subscriptions For WooCommerce
author: Techspawn

sections.description:
ReordeRe Lite offers a powerful yet user-friendly solution for integrating subscriptions into your WooCommerce store. If you’re looking to implement a WooCommerce subscription model, this plugin provides the essential tools to transform one-time purchases into a steady stream of recurring revenue using PayPal or Stripe. It simplifies the entire subscription management process, from product setup to automated billing, helping you foster customer loyalty and grow your business.

💡 Why Choose ReordeRe? Built for performance and ease of use, ReordeRe Lite delivers robust WooCommerce subscription features without unnecessary complexity. It’s designed as a lightweight subscription management system to keep your store running fast while providing a seamless way for customers to subscribe to your products or services. Get started easily with a focused WooCommerce plugin subscription solution.

🚀 ReordeRe Lite Feature List – Your Essential Toolkit for WooCommerce Subscriptions

  • Simple Subscription Products: Easily add subscription options to any simple WooCommerce product.
  • Flexible Billing Cycles: Configure recurring billing intervals (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly) for your subscription plans.
  • Secure PayPal & Stripe Integration: Automatically process WooCommerce recurring payments through PayPal Standard and Stripe.
  • Subscription Management Dashboard: View, track, and manage all customer subscriptions centrally from your WordPress admin area.
  • Automated Email Notifications: Keep customers informed about upcoming renewals, payment issues, and subscription status changes, improving customer retention.
  • Free Trial Periods: Encourage sign-ups and reduce initial friction by offering free trial periods before the first recurring payment.
  • Customer Account Management: Allow customers to view their active WooCommerce subscriptions and easily cancel them via their “My Account” page.
  • Optimized Checkout Experience: Provides a clear and straightforward checkout process for purchasing WooCommerce product subscriptions.

Upgrade to ReordeRe Pro to unlock the full potential of subscription commerce!

⭐ ReordeRe Pro Premium Features – Advanced Subscription Capabilities

  • Multiple Payment Gateway Support: Accept WooCommerce recurring payments through Stripe, PayPal (Standard & Express), Square, Authorize.Net, Mollie, MultisafePay, Payfast, PayHere, and more gateway options. (Also integrates with WCFM Frontend Manager).
  • Variable Subscription Products: Offer subscriptions with different variations, attributes, and pricing tiers.
  • Subscription Plan Switching: Enable customers to easily upgrade, downgrade, or switch between different subscription plans.
  • Flexible Payment Options: Offer manual renewals, sign-up fees, and allow mixing subscriptions and standard products in the cart.
  • Advanced Retry System: Configure automatic retry schedules for failed recurring payments to reduce churn and recover revenue.
  • Insightful Subscription Analytics: Access key metrics like Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR), churn rate, and subscriber growth for better business decisions.
  • Subscription Import/Export Tools: Easily migrate or bulk-manage subscription data using native WooCommerce tools.
  • Early Renewal Options: Allow customers the flexibility to renew their subscriptions ahead of schedule.
  • Priority Expert Support: Get dedicated assistance from our subscription specialists.

Get ReordeRe Pro Today for Advanced WooCommerce Subscriptions!

🎯 Ideal For Businesses Using WooCommerce Subscriptions:

  • Selling digital content, memberships (similar to a membership plugin), or software access with recurring billing.
  • Offering physical products through subscription boxes or convenient replenishment services.
  • Providing recurring services like maintenance contracts, coaching, or retainer packages.
  • Running online course platforms with tiered or timed subscription-based access.
  • Any e-commerce store looking to build predictable income and enhance customer lifetime value through subscriptions.

💪 Built for Growth & Performance

ReordeRe Lite helps you build a sustainable recurring revenue business on WooCommerce. Our plugin focuses on:
* Increasing Customer Lifetime Value: Convert one-time buyers into loyal, long-term subscribers with recurring purchases.
* Predictable Revenue Streams: Gain better forecasting insights with stable, automated recurring payments.
* Improving Customer Retention: Keep subscribers engaged and reduce churn with automated communication and easy account management features.
* Store Performance: Our lightweight code ensures your site remains fast and efficient, even as your subscription base grows.
* Establishing a Recurring Revenue Model: Provides the foundation for a scalable subscription offering.

🌟 Key Features of ReordeRe Lite – A Great Start for Woo Subscriptions

1) Quick Subscription Setup: Enable subscription options on existing simple products in minutes.
2) Flexible Pricing: Set recurring prices, billing intervals (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly), and optional free trial periods.
3) Centralized Management: Track all WooCommerce subscriptions and their payment statuses from the WordPress admin.
4) Customer Self-Service: Subscribers can view and cancel their active subscriptions via their standard WooCommerce account page.
5) Automated PayPal Payments: Leverages PayPal Standard for reliable, automated recurring billing.
6) Clear Communication: Automated emails keep customers updated on their subscription lifecycle events.
7) Optimized Checkout: Integrates smoothly with the standard WooCommerce checkout process.
8) Performance Focused: Designed as an efficient and lightweight subscription management system.

💼 Use Cases for WooCommerce Recurring Payments:

  • Subscribe & Save Models: Offer discounts for customers who commit to regular deliveries of consumable products.
  • Membership Site Access: Charge recurring fees for access to premium content, forums, or exclusive community features.
  • Software as a Service (SaaS) Licensing: Manage user licenses with regular subscription billing cycles.
  • Curated Subscription Boxes: Deliver themed boxes of products (e.g., beauty, food, books) on a recurring schedule.
  • Ongoing Service Packages: Bill clients automatically for retainer fees, maintenance plans, or continuous support.

Ready to Implement WooCommerce Subscriptions? Get Started with ReordeRe Lite Today!

ReordeRe Lite (Free)
* Create simple WooCommerce product subscriptions.
* Automated recurring payments via PayPal Standard & Stripe.
* Customer can view & cancel subscriptions from their account.
* Automated email notifications for key subscription events.
* Basic subscription management tools in WP admin.

ReordeRe Pro (Premium)
* Includes all Lite features.
* Multiple Payment Gateways (Stripe, PayPal Express, Square, Authorize.Net, Mollie, MultisafePay, Payfast, PayHere, etc.) for flexible subscription payments.
* Variable Subscription Products for offering tiered options.
* Subscription Plan Switching (Upgrades/Downgrades/Crossgrades).
* Advanced Dunning Management (Automated Payment Retries).
* Detailed Subscription Analytics & Reporting.
* Subscription Import/Export Tools for easy data management.
* More Flexible Options: Early Renewals, Manual Renewals, Sign-up Fees, Add-to-Existing-Subscription.
* Priority Support from our dedicated team.
* Integration with WCFM Frontend Manager.

Why Use ReordeRe for Your WooCommerce Subscriptions?

Managing recurring payments and subscriptions manually is time-consuming and prone to errors. ReordeRe Lite provides a streamlined and automated recurring billing system directly within WooCommerce.

  • Automation Saves Time: Forget chasing payments or manually creating renewal orders. ReordeRe handles the automated billing process via PayPal, freeing up your time to focus on growing your business.
  • Improved Customer Experience: Offer customers the convenience of automatic renewals and a dedicated area in their account to manage their subscriptions, enhancing customer retention.
  • Reliable Recurring Payments: Leverage the security and reliability of PayPal Standard for processing subscription payments automatically.
  • Centralized Management: Keep all your subscription data and customer information organized within your WordPress dashboard, integrated with your standard WooCommerce orders and customers.
  • Foundation for Growth: Start with the essentials in Lite and easily scale up to ReordeRe Pro when you need more advanced features like multiple gateways, variable products, or detailed analytics, ensuring a smooth growth path for your recurring revenue model.

Using a dedicated subscription management system like ReordeRe provides a more professional, efficient, and scalable solution compared to makeshift methods.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/reordere-lite-subcriptions-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin via the WordPress plugins screen (Search for “ReordeRe Lite Subscriptions”).
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Settings → ReordeRe to configure basic settings.
  4. Ensure PayPal Standard is enabled and configured in your WooCommerce payment gateway settings to process recurring payments.
  5. Edit a simple WooCommerce product, check the ‘Subscription’ box in the ‘Product data’ section, and configure the recurring price, interval, and period to enable the subscribe option for customers.
sections.faq:
How do I create a subscription product?

  1. Edit an existing simple WooCommerce product or create a new one.
  2. Locate the ‘Product data’ section on the product edit screen.
  3. Find and check the ‘Subscription’ checkbox to enable subscription settings for this product.
  4. Configure the subscription terms: set the recurring price, the billing interval (e.g., every 1, 2, 3…), the billing period (day, week, month, year), and optionally, a free trial length.
  5. Save or update the product. Customers visiting the product page will now see the option to purchase it as a subscription.

Which payment gateways support automatic recurring payments in Lite?

ReordeRe Lite supports automatic WooCommerce recurring payments via PayPal Standard and Stripe. This allows for automated billing without manual intervention. For more gateway options like Square, Authorize.Net, Mollie, MultisafePay, Payfast, PayHere, and PayPal Express/Advanced, consider upgrading to ReordeRe Pro.

Can customers manage their subscriptions?

Yes, logged-in customers can navigate to their standard WooCommerce “My Account” page. Within this area, they will find a “Subscriptions” section (or similar tab depending on your theme) where they can view details of their active ReordeRe WooCommerce subscriptions, see past recurring payments, and cancel future renewals.

Does this handle shipping and taxes on recurring orders?

Yes, ReordeRe Lite integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce’s core shipping and tax calculation systems. When a renewal order is automatically generated, the appropriate shipping costs and taxes based on your store’s settings and the customer’s location will be calculated and included, just like a standard order.

Is this subscription plugin compatible with my theme?

ReordeRe Lite is developed according to official WooCommerce and WordPress standards. It should be compatible with most well-coded themes that follow these standards. The plugin primarily uses standard WooCommerce hooks, templates, and the existing “My Account” structure to ensure broad compatibility.

Where can I get support?

Support for the free ReordeRe Lite version is provided through the community support forum on the WordPress.org plugin page. Users of ReordeRe Pro receive access to our priority email support system for dedicated assistance.
